definitions.explanation: The mathematical operation of adding numbers together.

examples.japanese: {足|た}し{算|ざん}の{練習|れんしゅう}をする。
この{問題|もんだい}は{足|た}し{算|ざん}で{解|と}ける。
examples.english: This problem can be solved with addition.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}に{足|た}し{算|ざん}を{教|おし}える。

notes:
{足|た}し{算|ざん} means addition (mathematical operation).

WORD FORMATION:
{足|た}す (to add) + {算|さん} (calculation)

FOUR BASIC OPERATIONS ({四則|しそく}{演算|えんざん}):
- {足|た}し{算|ざん}: addition (+)
- {引|ひ}き{算|ざん}: subtraction (−)
- {掛|か}け{算|ざん}: multiplication (×)
- {割|わ}り{算|ざん}: division (÷)

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- 1{足|た}す1は2: 1 plus 1 equals 2
- {答|こた}え: answer
- {計算|けいさん}: calculation
- {暗算|あんざん}: mental arithmetic
- {筆算|ひっさん}: written calculation

CONTEXT:
These terms are commonly learned in elementary school ({小学校|しょうがっこう}) and used when teaching children basic math.
